visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a dimly lit, cozy indoor space featuring a brown leather tufted armchair with a black and white chevron pillow. Large green tropical leaves and a Monstera plant frame the scene. (2) The camera moves through a doorway to show a white staircase with a black metal railing leading upward. (3) On the second floor, a narrow corridor leads to a small private dining area with a round white marble-topped table and a single woven stool. (4) Close-up shot of a North African Shakshuka dish on a white plate with blue trim; a metal fork breaks the poached egg yolk which flows over tomatoes and meat. Slices of toasted bread sit nearby. (5) Transition to a professional kitchen where a chef is stir-frying ingredients in a silver pan over blue gas flames; steam rises from the pan. (6) Close-up of XO sauce fried rice topped with large, glazed prawns and a sunny-side-up egg; a spoon lifts a portion of the rice. (7) Close-up of pumpkin risotto being stirred in a pan, followed by the plated dish featuring pink-centered pork fillet slices drizzled with dark sauce. (8) A bowl of chicken white broth ramen is presented; a hand uses a spoon to place a soft-boiled egg into the creamy soup and noodles. (9) Cubes of French toast are shown browning in a pan, then served on a plate with marshmallows. (10) Various drinks are displayed: a cocktail with a red-powdered rim, a glass of water with lemon slices, and a glass of dark amber plum wine on a branded coaster. (11) The scene shifts to a spacious dining room with light-colored sofas, white tablecloths, and a projector screen active on the ceiling. (12) The video ends with an exterior shot of the entrance, featuring a sign that reads 'Full Shot' and a circular glowing light with a smiley face.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional food review for 'Full Shot Bistro' (浮月餐酒館) in Kaohsiung. It aims to attract customers by highlighting the restaurant's unique 'hidden' entrance and private second-floor atmosphere, followed by a detailed showcase of signature dishes like North African Shakshuka, XO Fried Rice with prawns, and Pumpkin Risotto. The intent is to position the bistro as a trendy, high-quality dining spot for both meals and drinks.
